items.quote: The technician I worked with today was polite and very personable. He perfectly repaired my AC that was not starting up in just a matter of time without any problem. I will use him again in the future and highly recommend Home Air Conditioning Repairs to everyone.

We recently upgraded our AC system, and Home Air Conditioning Repairs handled the installation. Their team was professional, explained the entire process, and got the job done without any issues. The new unit works perfectly, and we are so happy we chose them for the job.

My furnace stopped blowing heat right in the middle of a cold snap, so I called Home Air Conditioning Repairs. They sent someone over quickly, and the technician was super friendly and professional. He got to work right away, explained what was wrong, and had everything fixed in no time.
